Simulated geocoded dengue cases of the metropolitan area of Guadalajara

Source: R/data.R
sim_dengue.Rd

**Simulated** geocoded dengue cases (2019-2024) of Guadalajara, Zapopan, San Pedro Tlaquepaque and Tonalá (Jalisco), with the columns of the geocoded dataset of SINAVE. They are not real cases: they were made to show the functions of the package (persistent hotspots, space-time interaction, transmission chains, intensity of cases) without publishing surveillance data.

Usage

sim_dengue

Format

A data frame with 5,502 rows (cases) and 15 columns:

VEC_ID

identifier of the case (simulated).

ANO

year of onset of symptoms.

SEM

epidemiological week of onset of symptoms.

FEC_INI_SIGNOS_SINT

date of onset of symptoms.

IDE_EDA_ANO

age in years.

IDE_SEX

sex (1 man, 2 woman).

CVE_EDO_RES, DES_EDO_RES

state of residence (14, Jalisco).

CVE_MPO_RES, DES_MPO_RES

municipality of residence.

ESTATUS_CASO

status of the case (1 probable, 2 confirmed).

DES_DIAG_FINAL

final diagnosis (dengue no grave, con signos de alarma, grave).

DENGUE_SER_TRIPLEX

serotype (DENV-1 to DENV-4) of some confirmed cases.

long, lat

coordinates of the residence (WGS84).

Source

Simulated with `data-raw/sim_dengue.R`; population of Kontur (popmex::hdx_pop2023) and localities of INEGI 2019 (rgeomex).

Details

The cases combine three processes: background cases placed in the 400 m H3 hexagons of Kontur 2023 (popmex) in proportion to their population; six persistent foci active every year; and transmission chains (secondary cases within 300 m and 3 to 18 days of a primary case). The onset of symptoms follows a seasonal curve with the peak in the epidemiological weeks 36 to 42. The script that makes them is `data-raw/sim_dengue.R`.

Examples

head(sim_dengue)
table(sim_dengue$ANO)
